name: scholarship-grants-finder
title: Scholarship & Grants Finder
description: Aggregate scholarship, grant and funding opportunities from education funding portals: amounts, deadlines, eligibility and application links - normalized for counseling platforms and search products.

input.title: Input schema for Pry Scholarship & Grants Finder
input.description: Aggregate scholarship, grant and funding opportunities from education funding portals: amounts, deadlines, eligibility and application links - normalized for counseling platforms and search products.

urls.title: Target URLs
urls.description: One or more https:// URLs to process.

max_pages.title: Max pages
max_pages.description: Hard cap on processed pages (runaway protection).

deadline_within_days.title: Deadline within (days)
deadline_within_days.description: Only emit opportunities closing within this window.

max_items.title: Max items (cost cap)
max_items.description: Hard cap on processed items for this run - keeps trial costs predictable. Billing stops when the cap or your spending limit is reached.

proxy_configuration.title: Proxy configuration
proxy_configuration.description: Apify proxy settings passed through to Pry's premium-proxy tier. Leave default to use the platform proxy automatically.
